about_the_game:
Twilight Moonflower is a first-person Japanese-style horror game where you aim to escape a terrifying residential area overrun by supernatural creatures.

Story

──That alleyway felt somehow “different.”

After graduating college, Souta (the protagonist), who develops games as an independent creator, decided one day to make a game set in his rural hometown. He returned home for the first time in years.

There, he recalled memories of a frail girl he often played with as a child.

“Come to think of it, where is she now? What is she doing?”

Before he knew it, Souta found himself drawn by those childhood memories to that very alley.

But that was merely the beginning of an irreversible chain of events—

About the Game

This online-enabled horror adventure can be played solo or with up to four players.

Players explore a dimly lit residential area with only a flashlight, avoiding wandering spirits while sealing supernatural phenomena to escape this otherworldly realm.

The key to survival lies in spotting anomalies and acting with composure.

Your keen observation skills will be tested amid constant tension—never knowing when the next attack will strike.

We bring you an unprecedented new horror experience.

Features

  • Online Co-op for up to 4 Players

    Team up with friends to explore and aim for escape from the otherworld. Play cooperatively at times, or sabotage each other at others.

  • Randomized Maps & Phenomena
    Map layouts, item placements, and supernatural events change every playthrough, ensuring fresh experiences each time.

  • Observation-Based Gameplay
    Strange changes occur in objects throughout the otherworld. Spotting these phenomena is essential to finding your way out.

  • Yokai Enemies
    Various yokai roam the otherworld. Explore cautiously to avoid being discovered.

  • Multiple Endings
    Your choices and progress determine the outcome. Three different endings are included.

  • Additional Features

    • Time Attack mode

    • Custom mode

    • Estimated playtime: around 3 hours

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM

short_description: A Japanese-style horror game for 1 to 4 players set in randomly generated residential neighborhoods. Explore a dangerous otherworld haunted by yokai, seal the supernatural phenomena that occur, and aim for escape. Experience replayable terror and tension with your friends.
supported_languages:
English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese*, Korean
*languages with full audio support
